title: Sheafification of an augmented affine Koszul complex
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an affine open of $Y$, $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$ and $I=i.\mathrm{ker}.\mathrm{ideal}(U)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Let $n\in\mathbf N$ and $f:\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to A$. Suppose the Koszul chain complex $K_A(f)$ [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], extended to cochain degrees by placing chain degree $k$ in degree $-k$, admits a quasi-isomorphism $\epsilon:K_A(f)\to(A/I)[0]$. Let $T$ be associated sheafification on $\operatorname{Spec}A$ followed by restriction along $U\simeq\operatorname{Spec}A$, and put $E=T(K_A(f))$, termwise. Then $E$ is bounded above, every term is a finite free $\mathcal O_U$-module, and there exists a quasi-isomorphism $E\to((i_*\mathcal O_Z)|_U)[0]$. No regularity is assumed apart from the supplied augmentation.

source.place: Tag 068C, affine Koszul resolution paragraph; Tag 0BQZ, local free Koszul resolution; Tag 01HV, exactness of the associated sheaf functor; Tag 01I9(2), affine pushforward

proof.text: The restricted immersion followed by the affine chart induces the surjection A -> Gamma(i inverse U, O_Z). The kernel is I by ker_apply and invariance under the topIso of the inverse open. RingEquiv.ofBijective of its kernel lift and isoSpec give a quotient-spectrum presentation compatible with the immersion. This is the proved private quotient_presentation lemma.
The quotient presentation gives an isomorphism T(A/I) with the restricted pushforward by affine_quotient_restricted_iso.

Positive cochain terms are zero by isZero_extend_X. In degree -k use the exteriorPower basis indexed by k-element subsets of Fin n, enumerate and ULift it, apply tildeFinsupp, and then mapFreeIso for chart restriction. Positive degrees are free of rank zero.

Apply the shared theorem tilde_preserves_finite_limits. Tilde is a left adjoint and preserves finite colimits. Chart restriction preserves finite limits and colimits, so their composite is exact. The chart restriction instance is supplied by the quasi-coherent kernel module.

Map the supplied augmentation by this exact functor. Compose with singleMapHomologicalComplex and the single complex of the quotient isomorphism. QuasiIso is preserved by all three maps and their composition.

theorem affine_koszul_finite_free_resolution
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (ε : (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) n f).extend
        ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)) 0).obj
        (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U))) [QuasiIso ε] :
    let E := ((tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) n f).extend
            ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
    (∃ N : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, N < p → IsZero (E.X p)) ∧
    (∀ p : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (E.X p ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := moduleRings U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace)
        (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) ∧
    ∃ a : E ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor U.1.toScheme.Modules 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))),
      QuasiIso a
